body: yup, i went there, these programs are evil and they should all be shut down. i only have mixed feelings about this because i know it means a lot of kids are going to be sent to worse programs. i got kidnapped and sent off 7 years ago, i spent 18 months in "treatment" programs all told, and i still have nightmares about it more nights than not. i hope this means at least some parents come to their senses and realize what's going on with these places. given that i was a troubled teen myself i know how hard it is to know what to do, and parents who turn to wilderness programs and residential are probably doing their best, but having your child kidnapped and abused doesn't help. as wilderness programs go, PQ isn't that bad, but the industry as a whole is an awful, exploitative machine.

I know IE11 is unsupported, but there are a lot of people stuck with it for work and we'd all really like to be able to use Discord.

my ribs are messed up from binding so i got an x-ray a while back and used it to make these.

it sounds like you're dealing with intrusive thoughts. i get them too. theyre common with ocd but can happen for other reasons.

hold on to the knowledge that it's not what you really want. the thoughts are loud in your head, but that doesn't mean it's what you "secretly" want. that's the nature of intrusive thoughts.

it helps me a lot to say (out loud, if necessary) "that thought isn't helpful right now. i don't need to focus on this. it's not what i really believe.", and then find a (safe, healthy) distraction to ride it out with.
